The '''''Valla's Glorious Gesture''''' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Vallaido Clan]]. The Vallaido children, including [[Siro Simito]], would begin their [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] careers by operating the ship's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].
